---
title: "Robustness Check: Preregistered Models"
output: html_document
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
---

The primary analyses use a cubic term for `depression_sum`, chosen in `Main Analysis.Rmd` section 1.5. This check refits the primary models as preregistered: with a linear term, and with the preregistered symptom x date interaction (prereg section 7). In the combined data, the interaction model also lets the symptom slope differ by study period. It compares predictions and risk ratios with the primary models.

```{r setup, message = F, warning = F}
library(here)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(mice)
library(marginaleffects)
library(tidyverse)
`%+%` <- paste0

source(here("Helper Functions", "Analysis Functions.R"))

pimh_c <- readRDS(here("Data", "PIMH - 2012-2019", "pimh_completed.rds"))
pih_c <- readRDS(here("Data", "PIH - 2019-Current", "pih_completed.rds"))
all_c <- readRDS(here("Data", "PIMH + PIH Combined", "all_completed.rds"))
```

```{r fit}
covariates <- " + age + race_recoded + gender + education"

specifications <- tribble(
  ~dataset,   ~data,  ~years,       ~extra,
  "PIMH",     pimh_c, c(2016, 2019), "",
  "PIH",      pih_c,  c(2019, 2026), "",
  "Combined", all_c,  c(2016, 2026), " + dataset"
)

models <- c(
  "Preregistered (linear)" = "depression_sum + decimal_year_centered",
  "Preregistered (linear, with interaction)" = "depression_sum * decimal_year_centered",
  "Primary (cubic)" = "poly(depression_sum, 3, raw = TRUE) + decimal_year_centered"
)

# Fit each model, keeping results only (summarize_fit() in Analysis Functions.R)
# Combined interaction model: the severity slope may also differ by study period, so the interaction is not confounded with the change between study periods
# depression_sum:dataset is in the combined interaction model only, so the two combined linear models differ by two terms:
# the interaction coefficient and its p-value are the test; BIC, predictions, and risk ratios differ by both terms
results <- specifications %>%
  expand_grid(model = names(models)) %>%
  mutate(
    interaction_extra = if_else(dataset == "Combined" & model == "Preregistered (linear, with interaction)", " + depression_sum:dataset", ""),
    formula = "dep_self_label_now ~ " %+% models[model] %+% covariates %+% extra %+% interaction_extra,
    summaries = pmap(list(data, formula, years), ~ summarize_fit(..1, ..2, years = ..3)),
    coefficients = map(summaries, "coefficients"),
    predictions = map(summaries, "predictions"),
    ratios = map(summaries, "ratios")
  ) %>%
  select(-data, -summaries)
```

## Preregistered Symptom x Date Interaction (Log-Odds)

```{r interaction}
results %>%
  filter(model == "Preregistered (linear, with interaction)") %>%
  select(dataset, coefficients) %>%
  unnest(coefficients) %>%
  filter(term == "depression_sum:decimal_year_centered") %>%
  kable(digits = 4) %>%
  kable_styling()
```

## Odds Ratios, Preregistered Models Without Interaction

```{r coefficients}
results %>%
  filter(model == "Preregistered (linear)") %>%
  select(dataset, coefficients) %>%
  unnest(coefficients) %>%
  odds_ratios() %>%
  show_table()
```

## Risk Ratios per Year

```{r ratios}
results %>%
  select(dataset, model, ratios) %>%
  unnest(ratios) %>%
  select(dataset, model, depression_sum, estimate, conf.low, conf.high) %>%
  kable(digits = 3) %>%
  kable_styling()
```

## Point Predictions

```{r predictions}
results %>%
  select(dataset, model, predictions) %>%
  unnest(predictions) %>%
  select(dataset, model, depression_sum, year = decimal_year, estimate, conf.low, conf.high) %>%
  kable(digits = 3) %>%
  kable_styling()
```
